newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR QUOTED MIXED AT TUESDAY'S CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR QUOTED MIXED AT TUESDAY'S CLOSE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on the rand and the mark but firmer against the U.S. currency and pound sterling at the close of interbank trade on Tuesday.
"We had a few (foreign currency) inflows but these were swallowed up in two-way interbank trade," one dealer said.
He added that the central Reserve Bank had also bought a few U.S. dollar off some banks at 11.3175.
The local unit ended the day at 11.3100/3200 against the U.S. dollar, easing slightly from Monday's 11.3080/3180, and was at 18.5130/5430 from 18.4925/5225 versus sterling.
It however edged up slightly on the mark to 6.5225/5310 from 6.5340/5380 and to 2.5070/5110 against the rand from 2.5140/5145.
